comment: Bundled fallback registry. Lookup precedence: exact_alias > substring_keys (in declared order, most-specific first per vendor block) > heuristic tier > fallback_tier_pricing. Pricing in USD per 1M tokens. Every entry MUST have a `source` block — prices without provenance are not accepted.

fallback_tier_pricing.comment: Used when a model name resolves to a tier via heuristic but has no exact entry. Numbers are conservative tier medians — favour under-pricing over over-pricing because over-counting USD is worse than under-counting.

special_markers.comment: Catch-all for any model name ending in `-free` (OpenRouter free tier, Qwen free, mirror endpoints). MUST be matched BEFORE any vendor entry.
